# Evan Munasinghe

> Evan Munasinghe is a full-stack developer from Sri Lanka and the founder of Aureus Technologies, a software studio. He builds business software such as point of sale, accounting, garage management, and marketplaces, mostly with Laravel and the MERN stack.

- Website: https://evanmunasinghe.dev
- CV (PDF): https://evanmunasinghe.dev/assets/Evan-Munasinghe-CV.pdf
- GitHub: https://github.com/evanmunasinghe
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/evan-munasinghe-3a8b3a279/
- Phone / WhatsApp: +94 71 468 2032

## Current roles

- Founder, Aureus Technologies (2026 – present): websites, business systems, and mobile apps for clients. Products include Invotron and Nimuzon.com.
- Full-Stack Developer Intern, Virtual System Solutions (2026 – present): Laravel applications, including the FleeV garage management system.
- Software Engineering Apprentice, Eyeplex Solution (present): ASP.NET Core web apps, REST APIs, MVC, authentication, and database work.
- Land Surveyor Assistant (part-time).

## Education

- BSc (Hons) Information Technology, Sri Lanka Institute of Information Technology (SLIIT), fourth year.
- Central College Anuradhapura: G.C.E. O/L 2019 (7A, 2B), G.C.E. A/L 2022 Maths stream. Senior Deputy Head Prefect.

## Skills

- Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Java, SQL
- Frontend: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Motion, Recharts, Hotwire Turbo
- Backend: Laravel, Spring Boot, Node.js, Express, NextAuth, REST APIs
- Data: PostgreSQL, Supabase, TiDB, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis, Prisma
- Cloud and DevOps: Vercel, Vite, Git, GitHub Actions
- Quality: Zod, React Hook Form, Playwright, Pest, Puppeteer, ESLint

## Projects

- [Invotron](https://www.invotron.store): multi-tenant point of sale, inventory, quotations, warranties and repairs, payroll, VAT, and double-entry accounting.
- [FleeV](https://fleev.net): cloud garage management system (Laravel, MySQL).
- [Nimuzon.com](https://nimuzon.com): online marketplace for natural Sri Lankan gemstones.
- [Pentakill](https://pentakill-blush.vercel.app): League of Legends pentakill counter using the Riot Games API.
- [Remind me](https://remindme-xi-nine.vercel.app): mobile app for tracking payments owed to suppliers.
- [Aureus Technologies](https://www.aureustech.online): studio website.
